scope.summary: Close PR #860 blocker issues #865 and #866 by removing non-hermetic repo-root filesystem coupling from the ERP parity test and downgrading unexecuted Verified claims to explicit gap tracking.
explicit_non_claims: No ERP platform service, runtime deployment, cloud integration, generated artifact, new dependency, Cargo authority, or production readiness claim is introduced.
No hand edits are made to *.generated.json.
The matrix remains a provider-neutral Rust structure/completeness contract; semantic parity remains GapTracked until executable checks exist.

hyperscaler_parity_evidence.issue_865_closure: The ERP parity evidence-reference test now checks repo-relative, no-parent paths only; it no longer locates repo root or asserts cross-domain file existence without Buck2 inputs.
hyperscaler_parity_evidence.issue_866_closure: All canonical matrix rows are GapTracked and the validator rejects HyperscalerParityStatus::Verified with UnverifiedHyperscalerParityClaim until semantic, crate-owned executable checks exist.
hyperscaler_parity_evidence.benchmark: AWS/GCP-class control planes and ERP SaaS administration surfaces require matrix status labels to be mechanically enforceable or explicitly tracked as gaps.

facets.F1_correctness: validate_erp_hyperscaler_parity_matrix now fails closed on Verified status because this crate does not yet own semantic parity evidence checks.
facets.F2_tests: Added a regression test that forces Verified and expects UnverifiedHyperscalerParityClaim; retained hermetic evidence-ref path structure checks without filesystem existence coupling.
facets.F3_maintainability: The fix deletes the repo_root helper and reuses the existing static matrix validator instead of adding fixtures, cross-domain Buck2 data deps, parsers, or dependencies.
facets.F4_compatibility: The canonical matrix remains valid with all facets GapTracked; the error enum change is additive within the owning crate.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, secrets, authorization expansion, runtime input path, external filesystem traversal, or external data flow is introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant, user, payroll, financial, or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: Hermetic Buck2 execution no longer depends on test current_dir containing specs/root-hub-pointers.json; future semantic Verified claims produce deterministic local and CI failure.
facets.F8_performance: Validation adds one enum comparison per static criterion and removes filesystem existence checks from the test.
facets.F9_compliance: The corrective PR carries multispectrum and audit-chain evidence, registers the evidence path in ADR-0315, preserves generated-artifact policy, and uses Buck2 as authoritative verification.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal revert of two Rust files plus evidence rows; no migration or live state is involved.
facets.F11_observability: Evidence names the two blocker issues, the exact parity criteria affected, local Buck2 commands, review gate status, and remaining no-runtime-claim boundary.
facets.F13_migration: Supports owned-stack migration by keeping ERP parity validation provider-neutral, Rust-owned, hermetic, and honest about non-executable semantic claims.
